description: Messages that name one envelope each, with the verdict the mechanism gives. Two checkers read this one table: `crates/plugin-rpc/tests/envelope_parity.rs` asks the Rust reference types, and `scripts/check_envelope_schemas.py` asks the committed JSON Schemas. A case belongs here when a plugin author could reasonably send that message, and both checkers must agree with `expect`.

cases.name: req-id-zero
cases.detail: 0 is reserved for a refusal whose request id the plugin could not determine (spec §4).

cases.name: req-id-max
cases.detail: The largest id a JavaScript plugin can carry exactly.

cases.name: req-extra-field
cases.detail: The envelope is open, so a profile may declare a field beside `params` (spec §2).

cases.name: req-params-null
cases.detail: The host omits `params` rather than sending null, but a plugin must still read null as absent (spec §4).

cases.name: res-both
cases.detail: A plugin that assigned a result and then failed; reading the result would report success while discarding the failure (spec §4).

cases.name: res-both-with-malformed-error
cases.detail: Only the result arm matches here, so `oneOf` alone would accept it and drop the malformed error; the `not` clause is what rejects it.

cases.name: res-result-null
cases.detail: `null` is a payload a profile may return, so a present `result` of null is a result.

cases.name: res-id-zero
cases.detail: The refusal a plugin sends when it cannot tell which request it answers (spec §5).

cases.name: res-refusal-no-text
cases.detail: `error.message` is required, so a refusal always carries text.

cases.name: hs-extra-field
cases.detail: The handshake object is open, so a profile adds its own top-level fields (spec §6).

cases.name: hs-dup-capability
cases.detail: A duplicate reports no additional ability (spec §7).

cases.name: hs-no-capabilities
cases.detail: A plugin may declare no capability at all; the host then reports every skipped behavior.

cases.name: hs-leading-zero-revision
cases.detail: The pattern allows any digits after the slash.

cases.name: hs-empty-name
cases.detail: `minLength: 1` on `name`: a plugin that names itself nothing cannot be reported on.
